admission.justification: Realized across worktrees/role_reports.py, cli/role_launch_enclosure.py, cli/role_launch_workspace.py, and memory/conversion/state_owners.py, and proved statically via AST producer/literal scans and dynamically via monkeypatch and state-conversion tests in mcp/tests/test_memory_verdict_ref.py and mcp/tests/test_knowledge_state_conversion_verdict_ref.py.

collect_group_reports, role_launch_enclosure.prepare_role_folders, role_launch_workspace._resolve_direct_workspace/_prepare_enclosed_workspace/_ensure_role_reports_folder, and memory/conversion/state_owners.py (_REPORT_MARKERS and _durable_verdict_ref) import COLLECTED_REPORT_DIRECTORY / COLLECTED_REPORT_PARTS / ROLE_REPORT_DIRECTORY / collected_report_ref rather than duplicating notes/reports or role-reports literals.

mcp/tests/test_memory_verdict_ref.py + mcp/tests/test_knowledge_state_conversion_verdict_ref.py (tree 2718751f903bcf3ac651da228bb24bb9b356bbec; 196 passed, 20 deselected, 22 subtests passed; 0 new layers.toml violations)

statement: The mapping from a report path relative to role-reports/ to notes/reports/<rel> has one shared definition (COLLECTED_REPORT_DIRECTORY, derived COLLECTED_REPORT_PARTS, collected_report_ref, and is_collected_report_ref) next to ROLE_REPORT_DIRECTORY in worktrees/role_reports.py, shared by collect_group_reports, every taskReportRoot producer (role_launch_enclosure and role_launch_workspace), and archived-task state conversion (memory/conversion/state_owners.py::_durable_verdict_ref).
title: One shared COLLECTED_REPORT_DIRECTORY definition governs report roots
